narrative.Summary: Implement the openclaw-voice CLI tool: a developer harness for manually testing call scenarios from the terminal. Uses MockVoiceProvider to simulate incoming/outgoing calls, displays call state transitions, captures audio stream output, and allows interactive text injection. Exposed as the bin entry in package.json.
narrative.Traces: FR-9 (CLI harness for interactive call testing)
narrative.Acceptance: openclaw-voice simulate-incoming --provider mock --from +1234567890 outputs call lifecycle to stdout. openclaw-voice --help lists all commands. CLI entry compiles and runs under Node 22+.

items.title: cli/index.ts — CLI entry and command registration
items.narrative: Commander-based CLI. Commands: simulate-incoming (trigger incoming call via MockProvider), dial (outbound call), inspect (print call state), version. Mirror openclaw's commander patterns.

items.title: cli/commands/simulate-incoming.ts — simulate-incoming command
items.narrative: Options: --from <endpoint> (default whatsapp:+15550001234), --media <types> (comma-separated, default audio), --mode <mode> (default talkback), --auto-accept. Creates MockVoiceProvider, triggers incoming call, auto-accepts if flag set, prints state transitions to stdout, exits on call end.

items.title: cli/commands/dial.ts — dial command
items.narrative: Options: --to <endpoint>, --provider mock (only mock supported in CLI for now), --media, --mode. Creates outbound call via MockProvider, prints state transitions.

items.title: test/cli/cli.test.ts — CLI smoke tests
items.narrative: Test simulate-incoming --auto-accept runs to completion without error. Test --help output contains expected command names. Test version outputs correct package version.
